twin_set_question.question: whether the E12/E13 twin set also enters the lane as a declared generated-image ingest
twin_set_question.recommendation: HOLD THE DEFAULT — emit renders only; twins ride as declared conditioning pairs (renders[].pair), not as a second asset
reasoning: they already have a home: renders[].pair declares a clay<->styled twin ON the emit render it corresponds to — lossless linkage carried from day one so the ~500-1,000-pair threshold activates retroactively

a separate ingest reopens the leakage the standing errand exists to close: twins are the SAME subject, so they either declare a different identity.subject_name (two families, one subject) or the same one (one family, two derivation classes — which renders[].pair expresses without ambiguity)
it would put per-view-inconsistent images (the owner-seam class, the dE 17.97 baseline) into a pool whose entire premise is view-consistency by construction

much of the set is superseded or rejected: Ruling 20b made it the E12 measurement record, superseded as production artifacts; Ruling 24b's crop twins — "nothing they painted is adopted"; style-registers.md law: nothing trains on rejected artifacts
twin_set_question.reopen_condition: the conditioning-pair threshold (~500-1,000 accumulated pairs), where the design doc already anticipates a conditioning-pair package type
twin_set_question.reopen_would_need: renders[].pair currently carries a path only; twins as training material would want seed+stem on the pair, i.e. a richer {path, generation} pair form — a small additive minor, DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT this session (speculative until the threshold is in sight; the twins' generation provenance lives in facet sidecars until then)
twin_set_question.reversible_note: 1.2.0/1.3.0 make the twins fully declarable either way; nothing here forecloses the Director's call
